answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 78 POA, slashed in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 16 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 78 POA on a stranger, so a farm needs 740 bought sponsors, each risking real money. A bridge of doubt is healthy, a harbor of proof is required, and a zephyr of patience is the price of a clean panel.
